app.name: kmdn
app.tagline: Collaborative markdown editing with a git backend.

signin.title: Sign in to {{instance}}
signin.subtitle: Use your work email. There are no passwords to remember.
signin.forgeNote: GitHub and GitLab sign-in only work for accounts already linked to a profile.
signin.checkBody: If {{email}} has an account, we sent a sign-in link. It works once and expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
signin.codeLabel: Or enter the 6-digit code from the email
signin.invalid: This sign-in link or code is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
signin.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

oauthError.no_account: There's no kmdn account for that forge account. Sign in with email, then link it from your profile.
oauthError.expired: The sign-in request expired. Try again.
oauthError.forge: The forge didn't complete the sign-in. Try again.
oauthError.taken: That forge account is linked to another kmdn user.
oauthError.generic: Sign-in with the forge failed. Try again.

verify.failed: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired.

admin.title: Create the admin account
admin.desc: You'll manage users, repositories and settings. You sign in with email links, so use an address you can receive mail at.
admin.name: Your name
admin.instanceHelp: Shown on the sign-in page and in emails, e.g. Northwind Docs.
admin.missingToken: Open the setup link printed in the kmdn server log. It contains a one-time token.

email.title: Email delivery (SMTP)
email.desc: Required. kmdn signs people in with one-time email links and sends invites. It never sends notification emails.
email.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password
email.fromHelp: Use an address your mail provider is allowed to send from (SPF/DKIM), or sign-in links may land in spam.
email.locked: SMTP is set in the kmdn config file or environment. Change it there.

forge.title: Connect GitHub or GitLab
forge.desc: After setup, connect repositories from the admin console: create a GitHub App, add a GitLab instance, or paste any git URL.

ai.title: AI provider
ai.desc: The assistant is optional. You can add a provider later in the admin console.

done.title: kmdn is ready
done.desc: Next, connect a repository and invite your team.

shell.publishedHint: You're viewing the published version. Revisions arrive in the next milestone.
shell.revisionsSoon: Revisions arrive in the next milestone
shell.noFiles: No pages in the content root.

home.noReposAdmin: Connect a GitHub or GitLab repository to start editing its markdown.
home.noReposMember: Ask an admin to connect a repository or give you access to one.

errors.network: Can't reach the kmdn server. Check your connection.
errors.notFound: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

repo.syncingBody: kmdn is fetching the repository for the first time. This usually takes a few seconds.
repo.noActivity: No published changes to pages yet.

file.missing: This file isn't in the published version, or it's outside the repository's content root.

settings.title: Settings
settings.adminOnly: Only repository admins can change settings.
settings.generalDesc: Where kmdn reads content and how it publishes.
settings.membersDesc: Roles are managed in kmdn only. Forge permissions are not used.
settings.dangerDesc: These actions affect everyone using this repository in kmdn.
settings.kmdnYml: This repository has a .kmdn.yml. It sets {{fields}}; change those in the repository.
settings.targetBranchHelp: Published is the content of this branch.
settings.contentRootHelp: Only files under this folder appear in kmdn. Leave empty for the whole repository.
settings.selfApproval: Allow maintainers to approve their own revisions
settings.selfApprovalDesc: When off, a maintainer who edited a revision needs another maintainer's approval.
settings.protectionUnknown: kmdn can't read protection rules for this remote.
settings.webhookGit: Send a POST to this URL on every push (e.g. from a git hook or CI) with the token header. kmdn also checks for changes every few minutes.
settings.webhookGitlab: kmdn registered this webhook in GitLab. If it's missing, add it with Push and Merge request events.
settings.noMembers: Nobody has a role yet. Instance admins can always access this repository.
settings.rolesHelp: Viewer: read and comment · Contributor: start revisions, edit when invited · Maintainer: review, approve and publish · Admin: settings and members.
settings.addPlaceholder: Add people or groups by name, or invite by email
settings.resyncDesc: Fetch the latest published content and settings from the forge.
settings.disconnectDesc: Removes {{slug}} from kmdn. The repository on the forge is not touched.
settings.disconnectConfirm: Type {{slug}} to confirm. Members' access to this repository in kmdn is removed.
settings.typeToConfirm: Type the repository name to confirm

profile.title: Your account
profile.desc: How you appear in kmdn and in published commits.
profile.name: Name
profile.commitEmailDesc: Used in the Co-authored-by line when a revision you worked on is published.
profile.linkFirst: Link a GitHub or GitLab account to use its noreply address
profile.customEmailDesc: Any address you can receive mail at
profile.linkedDesc: Sign in with these, and get credit for published changes on the forge.
profile.noProviders: No forge sign-in is configured on this instance.
profile.sessionsDesc: Sign out of devices you don't use anymore.

linkError.taken: That account is already linked to another kmdn user.
linkError.session: Your session changed during linking. Try again.
linkError.forge: The forge didn't complete the sign-in. Try again.
linkError.expired: The link request expired. Try again.

invite.invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired.
invite.title: {{inviter}} invited you to {{instance}}
invite.canRead: Read every page and every revision
invite.canEdit: Start revisions and edit the ones you're invited to
invite.canComment: Comment on pages and suggest changes

admin.title: Admin console
admin.only: Only instance admins can open the admin console.
admin.groupsDesc: Give roles to many people at once.
admin.reposDesc: Connected repositories and the forges they come from.
admin.emailDesc: Used for sign-in links and invites only.
admin.auditDesc: Security-relevant actions on this instance, newest first.
admin.inviteDesc: They get an email with a link to create their account.
admin.addToGroup: Add people by name or email
admin.githubAppDesc: kmdn creates a private GitHub App for this instance. You'll confirm on GitHub, then install it on the accounts whose repositories you want to connect.
admin.gitlabDesc: Register an OAuth application in GitLab (scopes: read_user) with the redirect URL shown in the kmdn docs. Repositories connect with a project or group access token.
admin.connectDesc: kmdn reads and publishes markdown from this repository.
admin.accessTokenHelp: Scopes api and write_repository, role Developer or higher.
admin.installOnAccount: Install the app on another account
admin.forgeError: Setting up the forge failed ({{code}}). Try again.
